content:
sara: Heads-up — running the longctx stress suite on the hybrid lab (2xA100 + 1xH100) and seeing repeated paging stalls around ~3.8M tokens. KV cache resident keeps growing even after evictions. attaching small traces below. Anyone else?

kai: can you paste the perf log? is this reproducible on a single GPU run?

sara: reproducible on single H100 but much noisier on hybrid. sample from profiler:

```
KVCache: resident=45.2GB used=43.9GB pages_evicted=12 pages_alloc=1024
Pager: stall_signals=46 avg_eviction_latency_ms=12.3
PagedAttn: page_faults=1589 reuse_hit=0.12
GPU: H100 driver 510.XX
```

mike: wait "stall_signals" — we added a signal-based backoff for the pager last quarter. could the signal handler be mis-serializing state? :thinking_face:

olga: I saw a similar pattern last month but we attributed to fragmentation + allocator rounding. this looks different because resident keeps climbing after eviction attempts.

perf-bot: alert: recurring high pager latency detected for suite longctx/v2 on host lab-hyb-03 — investigate. :rotating_light:

kai: two hypotheses: 1) eviction counter not decrementing when remote free completes (race), 2) page table bitmap getting stale due to tiling/stride mismatch on H100 kernels.

sara: repro steps I used:
1) run ./tools/longctx_runner --model pagedattn-v2 --seq 65k --iter 50 --batch 2
2) attach nvprof and /tmp/pager-trace.log
3) wait for stall_signals > 30

mike: can you dump PT entries around the time? i want to see if owner ids flip. a small snippet of dump format: `pt_dump --addr 0x7f... --count 128`

olga: also try forcing `REUSE_WINDOW=16` env var; if reuse heuristics are returning false negatives we might be evicting live frames then reloading repeatedly (causing growth).

sara: tried REUSE_WINDOW tweak — reduces page_faults but stall_signals still spikes. attaching a short dump:

```
PT_DUMP t=1799991150
slot 1024 owner=GPU0 state=VALID last_use=1799989999
slot 1025 owner=GPU1 state=SHADOW last_use=1799991101
slot 1026 owner=GPU2 state=VALID last_use=1799991120
slot 1027 owner=0 state=FREE last_use=0
-- repeated pattern: many SHADOW entries with nonmonotonic owner ids
```

kai: nonmonotonic owner ids are a red flag — suggests the PT shadow sync didn't complete before we scheduled a reuse. could be a missing memory barrier in the H100 kernel path after pagetable updates.

mike: i can try to repro on lab-h100-01 with a debug build that logs the sequence numbers. if we see out-of-order seqnumbers that's the bug.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime/debug-image:v2026-03-21-debug -> lab-h100-01 (ETA 5m)

olga: another data point — I ran same job on MI250 and didn't see the stall_signals spike, but we had a steady increase in fragmentation metric (hole_count). so architectures differ.

sara: good to know. could be a kernel-select branch that only runs on nvidia hw.

kai: action plan:
- mike: reproduce with seqnum-logging build on H100 (mike)
- sara: capture a larger pt_dump + per-GPU page map at next repro (sara)
- olga: run the MI250 longctx to compare allocator behavior and collect hole_count traces (olga)
- i'll audit the kernel path for missing barriers where pagetable writeback occurs (kai)

mike: starting repro now, will report logs in this thread. suspecting signal handler increments a pending_eviction counter but a completion path fails to clear it when cross-GPU free occurs.

sara: thanks — if anyone finds a quick mitigation we can flip the pager backoff to throttle earlier.

perf-bot: note: tagging blamelist=kernel-select, kvcache, pager for telemetry correlation.

mike: initial repro shows seq_mismatch at t=1799991282: `seq_local=2434 seq_remote=2428` on same slot before free. dumping full trace to /tmp/repro-1799991282.log

olga: uploaded MI250 run: hole_count climbs but no seq mismatches. attaching `hole_trace.csv`.

kai: thanks. seems consistent: H100 path yields seq reordering + shadow state; MI250 yields fragmentation-only. suggests both a bug (H100 barrier/ordering) and an allocator inefficiency on MI250. separate fixes likely.

sara: ok let's open a quick PR to add an assert in the pager completion path to catch seq mismatches and abort early in CI. also add extra memory barrier in the H100 kernel as a trial.

mike: on it. PR coming with repro logs and the assert.

sara: great. if we can get a hotfix for hosted-dedicated clusters that would help customer long-session tests tonight.

kai: agree — try a conservative backport: force earlier throttle when stall_signals > 8 as temporary mitigation.

mike: PR posted: https://git.redwood/repo/pager/merge/1234 (wip) — contains seq-assert + debug flags.

olga: I'll follow up with MI250 allocator tuning RFC next week to address hole_count growth.

sara: thanks team. I'll keep this thread updated with repro artifacts and impact numbers. :thumbsup:
